title: Implement capped haptic scheduler
acceptance: Two channels, bounded pulse duration/duty, outputs low at startup and cleanup.
evidence: Claim proposal only; implementation waits for Michael to merge assignment. First checkpoint uses simulated outputs for two-channel pulse/duty caps and startup/cleanup-off behavior. CS-009 remains a prerequisite for physical GPIO/motor validation.

25 scheduler tests plus 13 existing uploader tests passed on Windows/Linux Python 3.12. Simulation accepted two independent pulses and cleaned up both outputs off; no GPIO used. Includes 30,000 virtual 10ms stress steps (five simulated minutes), rolling duty, eligibility, fault/clock, startup/cleanup and independent worker tests.

Michael review reproduced actual 2050ms rolling usage after a delayed 100ms stop despite a 2000ms cap. Fix checks recorded rolling usage on stop/cancel and latches unavailable/both off. 41 edge tests passed on Windows/Linux, including expiry/cancellation overflow regressions and exact 2000ms boundary.
blocker: Software-only scheduler checkpoint implemented and simulated tests pass. Physical driver adapter/bench integration awaits accepted CS-009 off-state/logic/leakage/thermal evidence and its power/wiring prerequisites; no GPIO activation performed.
